purpose: Fleet-wide automation command center with rule inventory, status/search filtering, pinned cards, typed import, quick-start presets and vehicle-specific cabin comfort.
primaryGoal: Inspect and manage existing automation rules and start typed configuration workflows without losing operational controls or data trust.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the hook-owned envelope type while retaining explicit validation and rejection behavior; do not infer server acceptance from the predicate.

sourceStrategy: Filter row stacks below sm and uses min-w-0 (page:359-375).
Rule grid is one column until 2xl, then two (page:445-452).
Card header/actions and comfort buttons flex-wrap; preset descriptions break words.

issues.detail: Next-event title/time/location and recent run title (line 198) use truncate without a page-provided complete-detail disclosure. Long event content can be visually inaccessible at narrow widths.
issues.fix: Allow wrapping or expose full content through existing accessible disclosure; retain event location/time and run metadata.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: NOT EXERCISED at any required width; source reflow is not rendered overflow/long-label proof.

sourcePositives: Localized filter/search/file input names; decorative action icons aria-hidden.
Native details/summary retains browser disclosure semantics; page summary has explicit focus styling.
Statuses and firing indicators have visible text, not color only.
Action menu exposes expanded state, Escape handling and min-h-11 buttons; delete uses existing ConfirmDialog.

issues.detail: Every card switch is named 'Toggle automation'; menu trigger similarly uses generic 'Actions menu' in AutomationCardActions.tsx:45. Individual rules are not included in the accessible action name.
issues.fix: Include the source rule name in localized toggle/menu labels; preserve checked state and native focus behavior.

issues.detail: The page uses size=sm (AutomationCard:99); shared sm pin target is h-7 w-7 (28px). It is below the contract's 44px default, though an actual spacing exception cannot be evaluated from source.
issues.fix: First use supported className to provide min-h-11/min-w-11 for this consumer; any global default change belongs to shared owner and must preserve density/layout/pin semantics.

issues.detail: Details trigger explicitly sets h-8 w-8. Main page sm action buttons also resolve to 36px in Button.tsx:39; spacing and composed target adequacy are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Use existing button sizing/wrapLabel and 44px minimum where appropriate; measure actual mobile targets and spacing before claiming conformance.

unverified: Keyboard traversal and menu focus restoration

states.inventory: Initial skeletons; fatal QueryError with refetch; empty guidance + live create link; no-match reset; retained data remains with StaleRefreshWarning. Brief intentionally uses null metrics before successful response.
states.presets: Independent loading/error/empty/ready/retained SourceContent; refresh action for empty/fatal; category/search no-match state; gallery collapsed by default.
states.writeMode: Inventory and preset actuation disabled by canWrite; read-only notice remains. Comfort differs as finding below; client guard remains in place.

issues.detail: Falsy vehicleName is rendered as 'All vehicles', even when rule.vehicle_id is non-null and the vehicle lookup is pending, failed, missing or blank. Page:132 discards vehicle query state; page:457 passes undefined for unresolved scoped identities.
issues.fix: Pass vehicle_id and lookup state separately; show unresolved scoped vehicle identity instead of fleet-wide scope, retain source rule and offer source-specific recovery.

issues.detail: runsQuery contributes only data??[] (line 70); no runs loading, error, retained/offline or empty surface exists, and section is omitted when length=0 (line 190). nextState fatal is handled but its refreshError/isRefreshBlocked is not displayed.
issues.fix: Give next-event/config and runs independent DataState surfaces with retained notices/retry; keep recent-runs section with truthful empty/loading/error content and current five-of-ten display behavior.

issues.detail: Comfort save/now disable only on pending, while adjacent automation controls use canWrite. Comfort editor does not consume operational mode, so controls look actionable in historical/offline mode. client.ts:378 still asserts permission; no bypass or production mutation is established.
issues.fix: Consume existing operational mode to disable editor/actuation appropriately and expose writeBlockReason; retain request-layer guard and pending feedback.

issues.detail: Pin query loading/error/retained state is discarded and missing result defaults to no pins. SSE connectionState is also discarded at line 133. Inventory remains readable but pin ordering and lack of firing indicators have no source-specific uncertainty context.
issues.fix: Expose non-blocking pin/source recovery and stream connection context using existing source/status contracts, without replacing rules or fabricating activity.

visualIssues.detail: Preset disclosure hardcodes white hover background and cyan focus ring; fixed cyan decorative Sparkles at line 400 competes with neutral hierarchy.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current surface-hover/focus-ring/text tokens, reserving semantic hue for status and primary action; keep native summary and visible focus.

visualIssues.detail: All templates request cyan hover accent and cyan icon tile styling (lines 82-83), independent of category meaning/theme. GlassPanel.tsx:31 proves glow='cyan' is a tinted hover border, NOT an actual glowing shadow.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral panel hover and muted tokenized icon surfaces, preserving meaningful icon differentiation and saved themes. No shared palette reset or new surface component.

architectureIssues.detail: Duplicate and Export handlers only close the menu (lines 91 and 101); no duplicate request, builder navigation or download is invoked. They are visible existing affordances, not working features in this inspected snapshot.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must establish intended duplicate/export behavior using existing typed contracts; preserve labels/reachability and do not claim modernization added functionality or silently delete these controls. Router exposes per-rule export at router.go:3841.

architectureIssues.detail: Comfort requires useSelectedVehicle, but /automations disables header vehicle scope (workspaceScope.ts:95-98,156-168). This page supplies no required local vehicle selector. The panel can depend on a selection inherited from another route and otherwise only says to select a vehicle.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the fleet-wide rule workspace unfiltered; provide explicit comfort-local vehicle selection/context on this intentionally header-disabled route using existing selection ownership, or coordinate a deliberate integration policy. Do not enable duplicate global selectors or drop comfort.

architectureIssues.detail: Changing vehicle only resets hydrated; previous draft fields are retained until a stored config is available. An empty new config response can leave old vehicle values in the editor. Identity-scoped edit hydration and unsaved-change policy are not explicit.
architectureIssues.fix: Key/reset editor drafts by vehicle identity and distinguish unavailable config from valid defaults; preserve dirty values within the same vehicle and prevent old drafts being saved under a different vehicle.

architectureIssues.detail: Local parse/envelope failures use blocking window.alert, unlike mutation errors handled by existing toasts. The page maintains a second error presentation path without persistent inline recovery context.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse an existing feedback/dialog contract for parse validation, retaining translated reason, strict legacy rejection and file-input reset; do not replace validation with optimistic import success.

Prevent scoped-vehicle unknowns being labeled fleet-wide
Restore independent comfort data trust surfaces
Reduce decorative palette and improve named actions/mobile targets

No new shared component required by current evidence.
requiredSharedChanges.note: Adopt existing contracts, do not extend shared source speculatively.

Comfort manually branches one source and omits runs states while sibling PresetGallery uses canonical SourceContent; reuse current state renderer.
No competing theme/token/chart/table/query engine found in inspected page-specific source. This is scoped source evidence, not repository-wide certification.

sections.name: Your automations workspace with all source states

Toggle enabled; auto-disabled enable uses re-enable instead of toggle

dataBehavior: Auto-disabled takes precedence over enabled in count/filter/status; total count is loaded inventory before filters.
Search trims/lowercases without altering persisted automation names/descriptions; pins affect ordering only.
Do not gate presets, comfort or other independent sections behind inventory success.
Retain last-success rule/preset payload on refresh failure; never turn unavailable brief counts into measured zeros.
Preserve cache keys, polling/stale policy, cancellation, optimistic toggle rollback and invalidation/broadcast ownership.
Preserve five-second transient firing semantics; no activity-feed sidebar is currently rendered despite stale opening comment.
Inventory is fleet-wide and not date-windowed; do not add a header range request/filter without actual source support.
Preserve actual Celsius wire input and display-only useUnits conversion. Existing comfort lead_minutes is an observed contract, not permission for new non-SI fields or an audit-only conversion.
Keep typed import rejection, operational request guard, navigation destinations, pin identity and empty guidanceId automations.list.
Unknown scope/name/source failures must not be relabeled as all vehicles, empty history, offline or measured zero.
